summary: Full backend + frontend test of the discrete-tier USAGE_TIERS pricing migration. All 10 backend tests pass; all frontend flows (choose-plan, landing pricing section, checkout logged-out, checkout logged-in with real Stripe embedded iframe, settings volume-manager) work correctly. Prices match the 10-tier table exactly. Clamping works. One minor issue (duplicate data-testid) and one spec vs code discrepancy documented.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid="settings-volume-value" — one on Settings.js:571 (outer summary span) and one inside <VolumeSlider testidPrefix="settings-volume"> (VolumeSlider.jsx:24). Playwright strict-mode locator resolves to 2 elements. Cosmetic but breaks testability by test-id.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Remove the redundant <span data-testid="settings-volume-value"> in Settings.js:571 since VolumeSlider already exposes the same test-id via testidPrefix. Or rename one of them (e.g. testid="settings-volume-summary") to keep both.

SPEC CLARIFICATION (no code change needed): The review request states checkout for enterprise_yearly units=9 should show '$468,000 with a strikethrough original of $354,000'. The actual UI shows strikethrough $561,600. This is intentional: Checkout.js computes originalPrice = monthly * 12 = 46,800 * 12 = 561,600, which correctly reflects '2 months free' vs paying monthly. The spec's $354,000 figure is tier-8 yearly, likely a copy/paste error in the spec — code is CORRECT.
critical_code_review_comments: pricing.js (frontend) and USAGE_TIERS in payments.py (backend) are duplicated tables. Consider exposing /api/subscription/usage-pricing as the single source of truth and fetching it on the frontend (or generating pricing.js from the backend at build time) to eliminate the drift risk.
Duplicate data-testid="settings-volume-value" (Settings.js:571 + VolumeSlider.jsx via testidPrefix="settings-volume") — see UI bug above.

Checkout.js retains a stale legacy PLANS.enterprise_monthly/yearly block at lines 29-30 with prices $400/$3360 that is never used because isUsage branches around it. Should be removed to avoid confusion.
seed_data_creation: The backend tests created 8 pending payment_transactions rows for testpro (enterprise_monthly/yearly at various tiers). All are 'pending' status and harmless. Amounts verified directly against MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discrete-tier pricing migration is fully working. Backend: /api/subscription/usage-pricing returns the exact 10-tier table (min_tier=0, max_tier=9, yearly = 10x monthly for every tier). /api/payments/create-checkout persists the correct amount for each tier index and clamps out-of-range values. /api/subscription/update-volume returns 400 'No active subscription found.' for testpro (expected — no live Stripe sub) and never 500. Frontend: ChoosePlan, landing PricingSection, Checkout (both logged-out account-creation form and logged-in Stripe embedded iframe), and Settings volume-manager all render and interact correctly. Real Stripe test key is active so create-checkout returns client_secret and js.stripe.com embedded iframe mounts. NumberFlow (used on /choose-plan plan-price) renders animated digits in shadow DOM — DOM-text reads return only the '$' prefix; use screenshots to verify or read via .value attr / rely on backend tier math since same pricing.js drives both.
rca of the issue: No bugs to root-cause. Migration was clean. Minor duplicate test-id and a spec typo in the review request (strikethrough amount was tier-8 yearly, not tier-9's monthly*12) — code is correct on both fronts.
